You are a READ-ONLY code reviewer. Review ONLY for **simplification** issues — unnecessary complexity the new code adds. Do NOT hunt for correctness bugs. Do NOT edit files.

## Review scope (all newly-added code in /home/nick/work/hybrid_sim)
The `andes-sim` C++20 driver (feature work F0-F2):
- driver/main.cpp, cli.{hpp,cpp}, cli_test.cpp, models.hpp, cmd_list.cpp, json.hpp, json_test.cpp, engine_descriptor.hpp, process.{hpp,cpp}, engine_registry.{hpp,cpp}, repo_root.hpp, CMakeLists.txt
- scripts/build_driver.sh
- tests/andes_sim/parity.sh, test_andes_sim_f0.sh, test_andes_sim_f1.sh, test_andes_sim_f2.sh
- verilator/src/main.cpp (only the new `describe_engine` function, ~lines 39-100)

Read these files.

## Design constraints (do NOT suggest violating these)
- Depends ONLY on libc++ + include/hybrid/state_abi.h. NO third-party libs. Hand-rolled JSON parser is INTENTIONAL.
- json.hpp parallel keys[]/vals[] for object members is INTENTIONAL (incomplete-recursive-type constraint). Do not flag.
- Runtime path is pure C++ (no shell/python); build+test infra may be shell.
- Per-feature stub messages ("not yet implemented") in main.cpp are intentional scaffolding for later features.

## What to look for
- Redundant or derivable state; variables that restate something already available.
- Copy-paste with slight variation that could be one parameterized helper (e.g. repeated `find()`-and-extract blocks, repeated option-matching).
- Deep nesting or control flow that could flatten.
- Dead code, unused fields, or scaffolding that adds nothing.
- Over-built abstractions that could be a few lines.

Name the simpler form that does the same job. For each finding return: `file`, `line` (approx), one-line `summary`, the concrete cost, and the simpler replacement. Be conservative — skip anything whose change would alter behavior or is a matter of taste only. Return a concise bulleted list, strongest findings first. If already clean, say so.

1	// andes-sim command-line parsing.
2	//
3	// The grammar is deliberately tiny and stable across all subcommands:
4	//
5	//   andes-sim <cmd> [--model M] [--engine E] [--trigger T] [positional...]
6	//                   [-- <verbatim engine args...>]
7	//
8	// The single most important rule is the `--` boundary: every token after the
9	// first `--` is captured verbatim into `passthrough` and is NOT interpreted by
10	// the framework. That is what lets `fast`/`accurate` forward an engine's whole
11	// native CLI (e.g. `-gdb tcp::1234 -S`) untouched, so users see one simulator.
12	#ifndef ANDES_SIM_CLI_HPP
13	#define ANDES_SIM_CLI_HPP
14	
15	#include <string>
16	#include <vector>
17	
18	namespace andes_sim {
19	
20	struct Cli {
21	  std::string subcommand;                 // e.g. "run", "list"; "" if none
22	  std::string model;                      // --model fast|accurate|hybrid
23	  std::string engine;                     // --engine <id>
24	  std::string trigger;                    // --trigger csr|pc|icount|simpoint
25	  std::vector<std::string> positional;    // non-flag framework args
26	  std::vector<std::string> passthrough;   // verbatim, everything after `--`
27	  bool help = false;                      // -h / --help (before `--`)
28	  bool has_passthrough = false;           // a `--` boundary was present
29	  std::string error;                      // non-empty => parse failed
30	};
31	
32	// Parse argv[1..] (program name skipped). The vector overload is the testable
33	// core; the argv overload adapts it for main().
34	Cli parse_cli(const std::vector<std::string>& args);
35	Cli parse_cli(int argc, char** argv);
36	
37	}  // namespace andes_sim
38	
39	#endif  // ANDES_SIM_CLI_HPP
40

1	// The three models andes-sim composes from engines. A model says *which*
2	// engines run and *how* they combine; the concrete engine(s) are resolved
3	// separately (built-in qemu, or a discovered verilator:<cfg>).
4	//
5	//   fast      = QEMU alone (functional), transparent passthrough.
6	//   accurate  = one Verilator alone, pure from reset, transparent passthrough.
7	//   hybrid    = QEMU fast-forwards, Verilator measures the ROI (+ a trigger).
8	#ifndef ANDES_SIM_MODELS_HPP
9	#define ANDES_SIM_MODELS_HPP
10	
11	#include <string_view>
12	
13	namespace andes_sim {
14	
15	struct Model {
16	  std::string_view name;
17	  std::string_view engines;  // engine composition, for `list models`
18	  std::string_view notes;
19	};
20	
21	inline constexpr Model kModels[] = {
22	    {"fast", "qemu", "functional; transparent passthrough"},
23	    {"accurate", "verilator:<cfg>",
24	     "cycle-accurate, pure from reset; transparent passthrough"},
25	    {"hybrid", "qemu -> verilator",
26	     "QEMU fast-forwards, Verilator measures the ROI; pick "
27	     "--trigger csr|pc|icount|simpoint"},
28	};
29	
30	inline const Model* find_model(std::string_view name) {
31	  for (const Model& m : kModels)
32	    if (m.name == name) return &m;
33	  return nullptr;
34	}
35	
36	}  // namespace andes_sim
37	
38	#endif  // ANDES_SIM_MODELS_HPP

18	  bool timed_out = false;     // killed because it exceeded the timeout

4	// found by scanning a directory and asking each binary to self-report via

1	# andes-sim driver: a standalone C++20 executable.
2	#
3	# Intentionally minimal -- no Verilator, no SystemC, no QEMU, no fmt/spdlog.
4	# It depends only on the host C++ toolchain and the shared ABI header at
5	# include/hybrid/state_abi.h (consumed from F5 on for state-file reads).
6	#
7	# Build out-of-tree via scripts/build_driver.sh, which points
8	# CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY at the repo's build/ so the binary lands at
9	# build/andes-sim.
10	cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
11	project(andes_sim CXX)
12	
13	set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
14	set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
15	set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
16	
17	if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
18	  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
19	endif()
20	
21	add_executable(andes-sim
22	  main.cpp
23	  cli.cpp
24	  cmd_list.cpp
25	  process.cpp
26	  engine_registry.cpp
27	)
28	
29	# Shared ABI header lives at <repo>/include/hybrid/state_abi.h, two levels up.
30	target_include_directories(andes-sim PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
31	target_compile_options(andes-sim PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
32	
33	# Unit tests. Kept in the build tree (build/driver), not redirected to build/,
34	# so build/ holds only the shipped binary.
35	add_executable(andes-sim-cli-test cli_test.cpp cli.cpp)
36	add_executable(andes-sim-json-test json_test.cpp)
37	foreach(_t andes-sim-cli-test andes-sim-json-test)
38	  target_compile_options(${_t} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
39	  set_target_properties(${_t} PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
40	endforeach()
41

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Build the andes-sim driver: driver/ -> build/andes-sim.
3	#
4	# Standalone C++20 target (no Verilator, SystemC, or QEMU). Depends only on
5	# the host C++ toolchain and the shared ABI header under include/. This is the
6	# bootstrap consumed by setup.sh and `andes-sim build --what driver` (wired in
7	# F14). Out-of-tree build under build/driver; the binary is redirected to
8	# build/andes-sim via CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY.
9	set -euo pipefail
10	
11	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
12	BUILD="$ROOT/build/driver"
13	
14	cmake -S "$ROOT/driver" -B "$BUILD" \
15	  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
16	  -DCMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY="$ROOT/build" \
17	  >/dev/null
18	
19	cmake --build "$BUILD" -j"$(nproc)"
20	
21	echo "built: $ROOT/build/andes-sim"
22

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Differential parity harness: the closed-loop flywheel for the rewrite.
3	#
4	# Runs the same args through the Python golden (hsim) and the C++ driver
5	# (build/andes-sim), then diffs stdout+stderr and the exit code. As each
6	# later feature ports a subcommand, it adds its cases below; a green parity
7	# run is the evidence the C++ path matches the reference it replaces.
8	#
9	# F0 ships the harness skeleton with zero cases, so it exits 0 vacuously.
10	# Override the two binaries via the GOLDEN / NEW env vars if needed.
11	set -uo pipefail
12	
13	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
14	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
15	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
16	
17	GOLDEN="${GOLDEN:-$ROOT/hsim}"        # Python reference driver
18	NEW="${NEW:-$ROOT/build/andes-sim}"   # C++ driver under test
19	
20	pass=0
21	fail=0
22	
23	# compare <case-name> -- <args...>
24	# Invoke GOLDEN and NEW with identical args; require matching stdout+stderr
25	# and exit code. Records a pass/fail; never aborts so all cases report.
26	compare() {
27	  local name="$1"
28	  shift
29	  [ "${1:-}" = "--" ] && shift
30	  local g_out g_rc n_out n_rc
31	  g_out=$("$GOLDEN" "$@" 2>&1)
32	  g_rc=$?
33	  n_out=$("$NEW" "$@" 2>&1)
34	  n_rc=$?
35	  if [ "$g_rc" != "$n_rc" ] || [ "$g_out" != "$n_out" ]; then
36	    echo "[DIFF] $name (golden rc=$g_rc, new rc=$n_rc)"
37	    fail=$((fail + 1))
38	    return
39	  fi
40	  pass=$((pass + 1))
41	}
42	
43	# --- parity cases (populated per feature) ---
44	compare "list fixtures" -- list fixtures   # F1
45	
46	echo "parity: $pass matched, $fail differed"
47	[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
48

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# F0 contract: scaffold + build + parity harness for andes-sim.
3	#
4	#   1. scripts/build_driver.sh builds build/andes-sim (executable).
5	#   2. andes-sim with no args prints usage and exits non-zero.
6	#   3. andes-sim -h prints usage and exits zero.
7	#   4. tests/andes_sim/parity.sh runs (exit 0 with no cases yet).
8	#
9	# RED-then-green smoke test, run manually during driver development
10	# (mirrors tests/hsim/test_hsim_*.sh). Not wired into run_e2e.sh.
11	set -uo pipefail
12	
13	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
14	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
15	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
16	
17	BIN="$ROOT/build/andes-sim"
18	
19	# 1. build produces an executable
20	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
21	[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
22	
23	# 2. no args -> usage on output, non-zero exit
24	out=$("$BIN" 2>&1); rc=$?
25	[ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || fail "no-args exit code should be non-zero, got 0"
26	echo "$out" | grep -qi "usage" || fail "no-args output missing 'usage':"$'\n'"$out"
27	
28	# 3. -h -> usage on output, zero exit
29	out=$("$BIN" -h 2>&1); rc=$?
30	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "-h exit code should be 0, got $rc"
31	echo "$out" | grep -qi "usage" || fail "-h output missing 'usage':"$'\n'"$out"
32	
33	# 4. parity harness runs cleanly (no cases yet)
34	bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/parity.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "parity.sh exited non-zero"
35	
36	ok "F0 scaffold: build, usage, parity harness"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# F1 contract: CLI selection axes + `--` passthrough split + `list`.
3	#
4	#   1. list fixtures byte-matches the Python golden (hsim).
5	#   2. list models names the three models (fast/accurate/hybrid).
6	#   3. list engines scaffold exits 0 (populated in F2).
7	#   4. parse_cli unit tests pass (selection axes + `--` passthrough).
8	#   5. per-subcommand -h works (run -h mentions --model; list -h exits 0).
9	#   6. an invalid list target is a non-zero error.
10	set -uo pipefail
11	
12	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
13	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
14	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
15	
16	BIN="$ROOT/build/andes-sim"
17	HSIM="$ROOT/hsim"
18	CLITEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andes-sim-cli-test"
19	
20	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
21	[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
22	
23	# 1. list fixtures == python golden, byte for byte
24	diff <("$HSIM" list fixtures 2>&1) <("$BIN" list fixtures 2>&1) >/dev/null \
25	  || fail "list fixtures differs from golden"
26	
27	# 2. list models names all three models
28	out=$("$BIN" list models 2>&1) || fail "list models exited non-zero"
29	for m in fast accurate hybrid; do
30	  echo "$out" | grep -qw "$m" || fail "list models missing '$m':"$'\n'"$out"
31	done
32	
33	# 3. list engines scaffold exits 0
34	"$BIN" list engines >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "list engines exited non-zero"
35	
36	# 4. parse_cli unit tests (selection axes + verbatim `--` passthrough)
37	[ -x "$CLITEST" ] || fail "missing cli unit-test binary: $CLITEST"
38	"$CLITEST" || fail "cli unit tests failed"
39	
40	# 5. per-subcommand help
41	out=$("$BIN" run -h 2>&1); rc=$?
42	[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "run -h exit code should be 0, got $rc"
43	echo "$out" | grep -q -- "--model" || fail "run -h missing --model:"$'\n'"$out"
44	"$BIN" list -h >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "list -h exited non-zero"
45	
46	# 6. invalid list target is a non-zero error
47	"$BIN" list bogus >/dev/null 2>&1 && fail "list bogus should exit non-zero"
48	
49	ok "F1 cli + list"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# F2 contract: engine registry + self-describe (the plugin + hot-plug query).
3	#
4	#   1. JSON parser unit tests pass.
5	#   2. the built-in qemu engine is always listed.
6	#   3. a self-describing engine in the scan dir is discovered (--describe).
7	#   4. its kind / vlen / triggers show in `list engines`.
8	#   5. HOT-PLUG: dropping a second engine in makes it appear with no rebuild.
9	#   6. SIDECAR fallback: a binary lacking --describe is read from <bin>.json.
10	#
11	# Discovery is exercised hermetically via ANDES_SIM_ENGINES_DIR (which REPLACES
12	# the default verilator/build scan), so the real multi-MB sim binaries are
13	# never executed here.
14	set -uo pipefail
15	
16	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
17	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
18	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
19	
20	BIN="$ROOT/build/andes-sim"
21	JSONTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andes-sim-json-test"
22	
23	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
24	[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
25	
26	# 1. JSON parser unit tests
27	[ -x "$JSONTEST" ] || fail "missing json unit-test binary: $JSONTEST"
28	"$JSONTEST" >/dev/null || fail "json unit tests failed"
29	
30	# A self-describing fake engine: emits a descriptor on --describe, else fails.
31	make_engine() {  # $1=path  $2=id  $3=vlen
32	  cat > "$1" <<OUTER
33	#!/usr/bin/env bash
34	if [ "\$1" = "--describe" ]; then
35	  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"$2","type":"verilator","kind":"cycle-accurate","vlen":$3,"xlen":64,"triggers":["csr","pc","icount"],"roles":["standalone","accurate-leg"],"state":["resume","drain"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]},"result":"stderr:cycles"}'
36	  exit 0
37	fi
38	exit 1
39	OUTER
40	  chmod +x "$1"
41	}
42	
43	ENGDIR=$(mktemp -d -t andes-f2.XXXXXX)
44	trap 'rm -rf "$ENGDIR"' EXIT
45	
46	make_engine "$ENGDIR/sim_fakeA" "verilator:fakeA" 256
47	
48	# 2 + 3 + 4: qemu built-in present; fakeA discovered with its fields
49	out=$(ANDES_SIM_ENGINES_DIR="$ENGDIR" "$BIN" list engines 2>/dev/null) \
50	  || fail "list engines exited non-zero"
51	echo "$out" | grep -qw "qemu" || fail "built-in qemu not listed:"$'\n'"$out"
52	echo "$out" | grep -q "verilator:fakeA" || fail "fakeA not discovered:"$'\n'"$out"
53	echo "$out" | grep -q "256" || fail "fakeA vlen (256) not shown:"$'\n'"$out"
54	echo "$out" | grep -q "cycle-accurate" || fail "fakeA kind not shown:"$'\n'"$out"
55	echo "$out" | grep -q "csr" || fail "fakeA triggers not shown:"$'\n'"$out"
56	
57	# 5. hot-plug: drop a SECOND engine, re-run (no rebuild), both appear
58	make_engine "$ENGDIR/sim_fakeB" "verilator:fakeB" 128
59	out=$(ANDES_SIM_ENGINES_DIR="$ENGDIR" "$BIN" list engines 2>/dev/null)
60	echo "$out" | grep -q "verilator:fakeA" || fail "fakeA missing after hot-plug"
61	echo "$out" | grep -q "verilator:fakeB" \
62	  || fail "HOT-PLUG: fakeB not discovered without rebuild:"$'\n'"$out"
63	
64	# 6. sidecar fallback: a binary with no --describe + a <bin>.json descriptor
65	cat > "$ENGDIR/sim_nodesc" <<'OUTER'
66	#!/usr/bin/env bash
67	exit 3
68	OUTER
69	chmod +x "$ENGDIR/sim_nodesc"
70	cat > "$ENGDIR/sim_nodesc.json" <<'SIDE'
71	{"id":"verilator:sidecar","type":"verilator","kind":"cycle-accurate","vlen":64,"xlen":64,"triggers":["icount"],"roles":["standalone"],"state":["drain"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]},"result":"stderr:cycles"}
72	SIDE
73	out=$(ANDES_SIM_ENGINES_DIR="$ENGDIR" "$BIN" list engines 2>/dev/null)
74	echo "$out" | grep -q "verilator:sidecar" \
75	  || fail "SIDECAR fallback failed (verilator:sidecar not listed):"$'\n'"$out"
76	
77	# 7. (opportunistic) real default scan: if vsim is built, its sim_* binaries
78	# must self-describe and appear. Skipped when vsim has not been built.
79	if ls "$ROOT/verilator/build/"sim_* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
80	  out=$("$BIN" list engines 2>/dev/null)
81	  echo "$out" | grep -q "^verilator:" \
82	    || fail "default scan discovered no real verilator engine:"$'\n'"$out"
83	fi
84	
85	ok "F2 engine registry + self-describe"
86
